sentences.text: Nicolas Kim Coppola -LRB- born January 7 , 1964 -RRB- , known professionally as Nicolas Cage , is an American actor and producer .
He has performed in leading roles in a variety of films , ranging from romantic comedies and dramas to science fiction and action films .

In the early years of his career , Cage starred in films such as Valley Girl -LRB- 1983 -RRB- , Racing with the Moon -LRB- 1984 -RRB- , Birdy -LRB- 1984 -RRB- , Peggy Sue Got Married -LRB- 1986 -RRB- , Raising Arizona -LRB- 1987 -RRB- , Moonstruck -LRB- 1987 -RRB- , Vampire 's Kiss -LRB- 1989 -RRB- , Wild at Heart -LRB- 1990 -RRB- , Fire Birds -LRB- 1990 -RRB- , Honeymoon in Vegas -LRB- 1992 -RRB- , and Red Rock West -LRB- 1993 -RRB- .
